proof_scope: live non-expert analyst retrieval, abstention calibration, and declared knowledge-coverage over the SPARTA corpus

claims.proves: that a non-expert operator can resolve security identifiers across CWE/CAPEC/ATT&CK/D3FEND/NVD from the live corpus, that fabricated identifiers are rejected, and decisively that real-but-locally-absent identifiers return UNVERIFIED_LOCALLY instead of a misleading false negative; and that every framework declared covered in coverage_manifest.json still resolves; and that the framework alignment invariants hold live: zero unexpected orphan frameworks and zero cross-collection case collisions (check 30, EMB3D declared as expected orphan), zero edge labels contradicting their own endpoints and zero unlabelled edges (check 31), with a sensitivity case proving check 31 still reports the deliberately surfaced dangling-endpoint findings rather than having been vacuously weakened; plus non-deterministic e2e sweeps: a fresh random edge sample is endpoint-congruent and fresh verified-absent identifier mutants never resolve, seeds printed for reproduction
claims.does_not_prove: plausibility judgment -- whether an exploitation chain is realistic, whether a detection rule would false-positive in production, or whether an AI's threat analysis is operationally sound. Those still require a practitioner.
